quotes.speaker: JB Bickerstaff
quotes.summary_phrase: JB Bickerstaff takes responsibility for team's lack of execution
quotes.excerpt: I've got to do a better job making sure we're doing the things that we're supposed to be doing
quotes.quote: That's on me. I've got to do a better job making sure we're doing the things that we're supposed to be doing, the way that we're supposed to be doing them. When we do the things properly, we're pretty good. Right now, we're not executing our system consistently enough. We're putting ourselves in tough situations.
quotes.social_post: JB Bickerstaff takes the blame for the team's recent struggles saying that is on me and he needs to do a better job making sure the team executes the system consistently

quotes.speaker: JB Bickerstaff
quotes.summary_phrase: JB Bickerstaff praises Kevin's aggressive play against the Heat

quotes.quote: Kevin was a bright spot on the offensive end and really did a nice job creating his own offense. He's a really good basketball player that can do a lot of things. He can get to the paint, he can make shots, he can playmake. So we like to get him involved, try to get the ball in his hands, but I thought he did a great job of his opportunity.
